title: General.
officialText:
Refrigerators shall be tested in accordance with ANSI Z21.19 and shall be installed in accordance with the
manufacturer’s installation instructions.
Refrigerators shall be provided with adequate clearances for ventilation at the top and back, and shall be installed in accordance
with the manufacturer’s instructions. If such instructions are not available, at least 2 inches (51 mm) shall be provided between the
back of the refrigerator and the wall and at least 12 inches (305 mm) above the top.
SECTION FGC 626
GAS-FIRED TOILETS
